newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures close mostly higher, near highs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures close mostly higher, near highs.

text.p: April 22 - U.S. debt futures ended mostly higher, near peaks. Traders said June bonds strong as good buying, including from funds, lifted futures and shortcovering was seen in cash. They tied rise to good 2-yr sale, US stocks' rise, technical buying. Some said bonds also up on rumors of US budget agreement soon. Some see June bonds above 108-06/32 overnight.
